meta.title: Mathwa — Long-term rentals in Medina
meta.description: Apartments for monthly or yearly rent in Medina. Listings checked on the ground, direct contact on WhatsApp.

hero.title: Find your home in Medina
hero.lead: Long-term apartment rentals, checked on the ground, with direct contact on WhatsApp. No forms, no extra middleman.

commitments.title: What you can count on
commitments.lead: There is no payment and no booking on this site. These five rules are what make it trustworthy.

items.title: Seen before it is published
items.body: Every listing marked verified has been visited in person. The photos match the apartment.

items.title: An answer within 24 hours
items.body: You write on WhatsApp, someone answers. In Arabic, French, English or Russian.

items.title: The price shown is the price asked
items.body: Monthly or yearly rent, stated plainly. Nothing added at signing time.

items.title: What is included, written out
items.body: Water, electricity, internet, furniture, cleaning: every listing says what is included and what is not.

items.title: Rented places come down
items.body: As soon as an apartment is taken, it leaves the list. You only ever contact what is available.

audience.title: Moving to Medina?
audience.lead: Looking for a home from abroad, without Arabic and without knowing the districts, is hard. That is where we come in.

students.title: University student
students.body: Tell us your budget and how long a commute to campus works for you. We will point you to what fits.

families.title: Family settling in
families.body: Number of bedrooms, distance to the Haram, a quiet street: tell us what matters to you.

audience.cta: Tell us what you are looking for

steps.title: You filter
steps.body: District, budget, number of bedrooms, what the rent covers.

steps.title: You write
steps.body: The WhatsApp button opens a chat with the listing reference already filled in.

steps.title: You visit
steps.body: We give you the exact address and arrange the viewing with the owner.

closing.title: A question before you start?
closing.body: Write to us even if you have nothing specific in mind. It is usually faster than searching alone.
